Dear Counterparty,

I am pleased to present the following offer for your consideration:

**Transaction Structure: Flop-HTLC (Hashed Time-Locked Contract)**

I am offering to acquire **46,398 units of Nano (XNO)** through a flop-HTLC mechanism, providing verifiable cryptographic security for both parties throughout the settlement process.

**Terms & Conditions:**

| Parameter | Detail |
|-----------|--------|
| Asset | Nano (XNO) |
| Quantity | 46,398 XNO |
| Settlement Mechanism | Flop-HTLC |
| Hashlock | SHA-256 (to be mutually agreed) |
| Timelock | 24-hour window (negotiable) |
| Settlement Currency | [BTC/ETH/USDC — specify preference] |

**Why Flop-HTLC?**
